scenes.title: Unit Test tool
scenes.body: Prove custom field calculations against real loan data — SET, GET, and COMPARE in one browser grid.

scenes.title: Generate & load
scenes.body: Load from Excel or generate from a calculated custom field. Preview SET and COMPARE steps, then load into the grid.

scenes.title: Test Grid
scenes.body: All cells are editable. Date fields get a date picker; numbers and booleans use type-aware editors.

scenes.title: Run tests
scenes.body: Enter a Loan GUID from your Encompass pipeline. Pass and fail shading shows whether calculated values match.

scenes.title: Search · export · reload
scenes.body: Search by field ID for impact analysis. Export to Excel or CSV and reload saved workbooks from the Test Library.

scenes.title: Parser training · assistant
scenes.body: Learn Mode pairs VB parser logic with worked cases. The AI Assistant answers unit-testing and Encompass questions.

scenes.title: Offline demo + highlight reel
scenes.body: Open unit-tests.html with the sample field, then play the in-page highlight reel to walk every section.
